options.command: if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then go vet ./...; else podman run --rm -v $(pwd):/app:Z -w /app docker.io/library/golang:1.23-alpine go vet ./...; fi
if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then go test -v ./...; else podman run --rm -v $(pwd):/app:Z -w /app docker.io/library/golang:1.23-alpine go test -v ./...; fi

if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o bubble-server ./cmd/server; else podman run --rm -v $(pwd):/app:Z -w /app docker.io/library/golang:1.23-alpine sh -c 'CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o bubble-server ./cmd/server'; fi
